summary: CRITICAL OMISSIONS: MatrixGenerator.Tests.ps1 is referenced in workflow but not provided. Fixture files (basic.json, with-flags.json, minimal.json, oversized) are required by Test-ActWorkflow.ps1 but absent—tests cannot run without them. .actrc is listed in projectFiles but never defined. Module logic is sound (cartesian products, include/exclude); workflow structure is reasonable. But error-handling is weak: Import-Module lacks -ErrorAction Stop, Pester install check missing -ErrorAction on command, workflow JSON parsing doesn't validate structure before use. No actionlint validation output or act-result.txt provided. Submission incomplete—would fail at first act invocation.
